rate_table_note: Rates are in WAC 284-34-150(1)(a), printed as "Sixty cents" and "Ninety-six cents". Single premium rates are computed from these with the formula in (2) (not recorded). WAC 284-34-210: the commissioner reviews the rates every three years and publishes new statewide rates if needed. Filed 1/4/05, effective 4/1/05 (WSR 05-02-076, Matter No. R 2002-02); no later amendment is listed in the section.
source_title: WAC 284-34-150, What are the standards for prima facie credit life insurance rates? (Washington State Legislature)
summary: Rates in force: Washington's prima facie credit life rates in WAC 284-34-150: 60 cents (single life) and 96 cents (joint life) per month per $1,000 of outstanding insured debt, effective April 1, 2005.
